items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: He was called Lil' Walker's best piano player. I can't remember his name either.

ctx.x: But there was one piano player they played. He was called Lil' Walker's best piano player. I can't remember his name either.
You were the only New Orleans man, then, in Whitliff's band, or what you've been telling me.
